formalInterfaceLimits.spawn_agent: Supports an explicit reasoning_effort parameter. An explicit override requires fork_turns=none; omitting model keeps the parent model default.

formalInterfaceLimits.list_agents: Returns names and statuses; no model, speed-tier or reasoning-effort fields are exposed.
